query: SELECT r.schedule_id, r.tick, r.inventory, s.name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'sent') AS "sent!", 'tick:' || (extract(epoch from r.tick) * 1000)::bigint::text || ':' || r.schedule_id::text || ':' || r.inventory AS "key!" FROM schedule_run r JOIN schedule s ON s.org_id = r.org_id AND s.id = r.schedule_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR r.tick < $2 OR (r.tick = $2 AND 'tick:' || (extract(epoch from r.tick) * 1000)::bigint::text || ':' || r.schedule_id::text || ':' || r.inventory > $4)) GROUP BY r.schedule_id, r.tick, r.inventory, s.name ORDER BY r.tick DESC, 'tick:' || (extract(epoch from r.tick) * 1000)::bigint::text || ':' || r.schedule_id::text || ':' || r.inventory LIMIT $3
